inventive_nucleus: A gel-resistant electrode material is integrated into the ECG monitor to prevent signal quality degradation caused by electrode gel degradation.

claim_versions.claim: A gel-resistant electrode material is integrated into the ECG monitor, wherein the material is designed to operate in a high-humidity environment and has a degradation rate that is at least 30% slower than a conventional electrode material, thereby improving signal quality and reducing maintenance requirements.

redesign.new_claim: A gel-resistant electrode material is integrated into the ECG monitor, wherein the material is designed to operate in a high-humidity environment and has a degradation rate that is at least 30% slower than a conventional electrode material, thereby improving signal quality and reducing maintenance requirements.
redesign.change: Added a specific operating condition (high-humidity environment) and a quantitative measure of the technical effect (degradation rate of at least 30% slower than a conventional electrode material).
redesign.reason: This revised claim should survive the prior-art attack because it focuses on the distinguishing feature of the gel-resistant electrode material (operating in a high-humidity environment) and its technical effect (improving signal quality and reducing maintenance requirements) under a specific operating condition, making it more difficult for a skilled person to combine existing references to achieve the same result.
